keyFindings.title: Five packet docs miss the required Overview section
Hub SKILL.md misdescribes the transport default
score-clarify-default.cjs drops the answering route; catalog five-scorer claim does not reconcile with code
Transport-integration measurement doc claims a route record score-clarify-default does not write
Pi-transport test README claims 41 cases; the suite holds 46
Approved advisor divergence: non-Jev score prompt reaches cli-classifier natively
The jev install prerequisite is not surfaced where an external user starts
Hub changelog and version metadata lag the 2026-10-03 injection-screen improvements present in shipped files
Packet summary recording the hub's live result misstates the review band (0.25-0.75 vs code 0.25-0.60)

ruledOutDirections.text: README/SKILL version lag as drift (repo-wide convention)
cli-deem changelog mentions as stale references (historical records)
Benchmark-report validation failures as hub defect (repo-wide ungoverned type)
Auto-detect fallback warnings on ROUTER/catalogs/playbooks as defects
Callers' older box headers as violations (grandfathered)
hub_skills omission as a defect (degree metric)
Keyword-set difference vs mode routers as a defect (not contract-enforced)
Older reports' --hub cli-jev command as stale (dated records)
Measurement docs lacking a results section as hub drift (method-doc design)
